inputBoundary: One already-derived finite dwell duration in minutes for one visit to a source-defined study area.
outputBoundary: Classify the visit as not a study period below 20 minutes and as a study period at or above 20 minutes; equality is retained.
limitations: This binding does not define or identify a study area such as a library, lab, study room, or cafe.
This binding does not map location observations to a study area.
This binding does not reconstruct visits or derive their dwell durations.
This binding does not apply the adjacent activity or audio focus heuristics.
This binding does not infer grades, GPA, or another academic outcome.
A missing or non-finite study-area dwell duration fails closed rather than being interpreted as zero.
